nodes.name: RootErrorBoundary.tsx
nodes.summary: Renders the router-level failure screen and performs a guarded one-time reload when a deployment leaves the browser with stale dynamic chunk URLs.

nodes.name: RootErrorBoundary
nodes.summary: Interprets router errors, detects stale dynamic chunks, reloads at most once automatically, and otherwise presents a branded recovery screen.

nodes.name: ThemeToggle.tsx
nodes.summary: Provides an accessible light/dark theme toggle that resolves system preference, persists the selected mode, and adds native haptic feedback.

nodes.name: ThemeToggle
nodes.summary: Tracks the operating-system color preference, resolves the active theme, and persists the opposite explicit mode when pressed.

nodes.name: Button.tsx
nodes.summary: Defines the reusable button primitive with visual variants, size presets, forwarded refs, disabled behavior, and optional haptic feedback.

nodes.name: Toast.tsx
nodes.summary: Mounts the animated global toast stack, maps toast tones to styling, and triggers success or error haptics once per notification.

nodes.name: Toaster
nodes.summary: Renders dismissible animated toasts from the UI store and emits a single tone-appropriate haptic for each new item.

nodes.name: useMediaQuery.ts
nodes.summary: Exposes a reactive media-query hook with server-safe initialization and listener cleanup when the query changes.

nodes.name: useMediaQuery
nodes.summary: Returns whether a CSS media query currently matches and keeps the value synchronized through a browser change listener.

nodes.name: buddy.ts
nodes.summary: Provides pure Buddy messaging helpers for realtime topic names, privacy-safe shared question references, message merging, conversation grouping, and compact timestamps.

nodes.name: buddyPresenceTopic
nodes.summary: Builds the shared Supabase Presence topic name for a Buddy relationship.

nodes.name: buddyRealtimeTopic
nodes.summary: Builds the realtime chat and typing topic name for a Buddy relationship.

nodes.name: buddyPresenceUserIds
nodes.summary: Extracts user IDs that currently have at least one active Presence connection.

nodes.name: safeQuestionRef
nodes.summary: Projects a question row onto the privacy-safe fields permitted in Buddy sharing.

nodes.name: mergeBuddyMessages
nodes.summary: Deduplicates optimistic and realtime Buddy messages by ID and returns them in chronological order.

nodes.name: groupBuddyMessages
nodes.summary: Groups chronological Buddy messages by day and clusters nearby text messages from the same sender into conversational turns.

nodes.name: shortBuddyTime
nodes.summary: Formats a chat timestamp as now, local time, Yesterday, weekday, or compact date according to recency.

nodes.name: isSharedQuestionRef
nodes.summary: Checks that an unknown value has the minimum shape required for a shared question reference.

nodes.name: buddyNotifications.ts
nodes.summary: Coordinates web and native push registration for Buddy and study channels, persists per-device opt-ins, invokes notification services, and manages quiet-hour snoozes.

nodes.name: getPushDeviceId
nodes.summary: Returns the stable per-browser push device ID, creating and persisting one when needed.

nodes.name: buddyPushOptedIn
nodes.summary: Reads whether the current device opted into Buddy message notifications.

nodes.name: studyPushOptedIn
nodes.summary: Reads whether the current device opted into scheduled study notifications.

nodes.name: pushNotificationsOptedIn
nodes.summary: Reports whether either notification channel is enabled on the current device.

nodes.name: urlBase64ToUint8Array
nodes.summary: Decodes a URL-safe VAPID public key into the byte array required by the Web Push API.

nodes.name: upsertWebSubscription
nodes.summary: Validates a browser push subscription, upserts its endpoint and keys through Supabase, and synchronizes channel flags.

nodes.name: saveNativePushToken
nodes.summary: Persists a trimmed native push token for the opted-in device and synchronizes its enabled channels.

nodes.name: registerNativeToken
nodes.summary: Creates Android notification channels and resolves a native registration token with listener cleanup and a bounded timeout.

nodes.name: getBuddyNotificationState
nodes.summary: Combines platform support, permission status, server registration, and local opt-in state for the settings UI.

nodes.name: enableNotificationChannel
nodes.summary: Requests platform permission, registers a web or native subscription, and rolls back the selected channel on failure.

nodes.name: enableBuddyNotifications
nodes.summary: Enables the Buddy-message notification channel on this device.

nodes.name: enableStudyNotifications
nodes.summary: Enables the scheduled-study notification channel on this device.

nodes.name: disableNotificationChannel
nodes.summary: Clears one local channel opt-in and synchronizes the remaining channel flags to Supabase.

nodes.name: disableBuddyNotifications
nodes.summary: Disables Buddy-message notifications while preserving any study-reminder registration.

nodes.name: disableStudyNotifications
nodes.summary: Disables study reminders while preserving any Buddy-message registration.

nodes.name: unregisterCurrentPushDevice
nodes.summary: Disables both channels and removes the current web or native push registration locally and on Supabase.

nodes.name: syncBuddyPushRegistration
nodes.summary: Refreshes an existing permitted web subscription or rotated native token without prompting the user.

nodes.name: touchActiveBuddy
nodes.summary: Updates the active Buddy association for the current push device so foreground conversations can be suppressed.

nodes.name: notifyBuddyMessage
nodes.summary: Invokes the Buddy notification function as a best-effort fast path for a newly created message.

nodes.name: routeFromPushData
nodes.summary: Accepts only safe application-relative routes from arbitrary push-notification payload data.

nodes.name: snoozeNotifications
nodes.summary: Sets bounded device-level push quiet hours through Supabase and returns a structured result.

nodes.name: clearSnooze
nodes.summary: Clears device-level notification quiet hours through the shared Supabase RPC.

nodes.name: getSnoozeStatus
nodes.summary: Fetches the current device quiet-until timestamp and reports only a still-active snooze.

nodes.name: edge.ts
nodes.summary: Supplies typed client wrappers around Supabase Edge Functions for access requests, invite approval, username/PIN authentication, PIN recovery, and Buddy requests.

nodes.name: requestAccess
nodes.summary: Posts a public access request with anon credentials and normalizes transport and service failures into a typed edge error.

nodes.name: approveRequest
nodes.summary: Authorizes and submits an owner approval request, returning the created invite and mail-delivery status.

nodes.name: declineRequest
nodes.summary: Authorizes and submits an owner decline decision with an optional reason and notification preference.

nodes.name: isEdgeError
nodes.summary: Narrows an unknown response to the shared failed Edge Function result shape.

nodes.name: signupViaInvite
nodes.summary: Creates an invite-backed username/PIN account through the public signup function and validates its success payload.

nodes.name: loginWithUsernamePin
nodes.summary: Exchanges a username and PIN for Supabase session tokens through the login Edge Function.

nodes.name: requestPinReset
nodes.summary: Requests a non-enumerating PIN recovery workflow for a username.

nodes.name: sendBuddyRequest
nodes.summary: Submits an authenticated Buddy request and preserves the server status that explains creation, cooldowns, or rejection.

nodes.name: isUsernameAvailable
nodes.summary: Performs an optional preflight username availability RPC and fails open so authoritative signup validation remains usable.

nodes.name: lazyWithRetry.ts
nodes.summary: Wraps React lazy imports with one-time reload recovery for stale deployment chunks while preserving ordinary module-load errors.

nodes.name: lazyWithRetry
nodes.summary: Creates a React lazy component that reloads once after chunk-version failures and rethrows unrelated or repeated errors.

nodes.name: native.ts
nodes.summary: Centralizes Capacitor platform detection, best-effort haptics, system chrome styling, deep-link parsing, and Android back-button policy.

nodes.name: haptic
nodes.summary: Maps semantic feedback intents to Capacitor haptic actions and suppresses unsupported, disabled, or failed feedback.

nodes.name: configureNativeChrome
nodes.summary: Applies the resolved light or dark style to native system bars and the software keyboard without blocking startup.

nodes.name: routeFromAppUrl
nodes.summary: Parses custom-scheme or HTTP application links into an internal path while rejecting malformed URLs.

nodes.name: resolveNativeBackAction
nodes.summary: Selects history, root routing, exit arming, or app exit from the current route and recent back-button state.
